artifact_contract.teardown: Foreground CPU process exits; immutable hard-linked inputs remain; no provider, GPU, endpoint, or external state exists.

baseline_measurement.attribution: Dense control is one full physical read of all 262144 tied BF16 rows. Candidate traffic is the 32-query physical union plus every declared fixed-index, metadata, score, bound, survivor, and exact-verification byte.
baseline_measurement.critical_path_scope: Analytical output-head memory traffic only; CPU runtime is diagnostic and cannot transfer to H200 latency.
baseline_measurement.residual_bottleneck: A disjoint query may have a large residual outside the frozen training span, widening every row certificate and making the physical survivor union dense.

candidate.frozen_change: Reuse predecessor persisted rank-32 basis, projected weight coefficients, and per-row residual upper bounds without changing any byte, rank, threshold, or guard.
candidate.held_out_selection: For each request in first-seen request order, select its second capture-order row. This metadata-only rule is fixed before scoring.
candidate.name: frozen rank-32 low-rank residual index on disjoint exact queries

causal_hypothesis: If the predecessor's 32-dimensional query span captures reusable output-head query structure rather than memorizing its fit/evaluation rows, the frozen residual certificates will preserve every possible stock candidate while keeping the 32-query physical exact-weight union small enough that fully charged net traffic remains below dense. The competing explanation is in-sample collapse: disjoint query residuals widen bounds until survivor traffic is nonpositive.

required: All frozen file hashes, tensor geometry, dtypes, and tied-weight tensor digest match.
The 32 held-out rows are disjoint from all 32 predecessor fit/evaluation rows by capture storage index, global row, ownership tuple, and BF16 row hash.
Every possible non-stop stock argmax under the inherited conservative numeric envelope remains in every reported survivor set.
Every dense reference winner remains and exact candidate winners match dense reference winners.
All original token rows remain reachable in original token-ID order.
correctness_gate.semantics: Lossless containment of the complete pinned stock candidate set, not top-1 agreement alone.

decision_gate.falsify: Exact stock-set containment fails or fully charged net physical traffic is nonpositive.
decision_gate.promote: Exact stock-set containment holds and fully charged net physical bytes avoided is strictly positive.
decision_gate.single_shot: One deterministic held-out invocation only. No parameter, basis, rank, threshold, guard, or row-selection tuning after result observation.
decision_gate.transfer_limit: CPU/reference correctness and analytical physical bytes for these 32 exact held-out rows only.

question: Does the frozen predecessor rank-32 residual index preserve the exact stock candidate set and reduce fully charged net physical output-head traffic on 32 exact-capture hidden rows disjoint from every fit/evaluation row?
seed: No stochastic operations. Selection is the preregistered second-row-per-request rule.

stock_consumer.candidate_set_requirement: Every possible non-stop argmax under the inherited conservative FP32-reference, BF16-accumulation, and BF16-output-rounding envelope remains in the survivor set.

workload.geometry: 32 preregistered held-out hidden rows by 262144 token rows by hidden width 5376
workload.physical_scope: 32-query union of original tied-weight rows read for exact verification
traffic_charges: full original BF16 rows in the physical survivor union
